sourceSentences: [0] Consider playing a bit more cautiously around Kennen when you have a Mark of the Storm debuff.
[0] If he hits you with 3 Marks of the Storm, you will get stunned.
[0] Kennen is flimsy by nature - turn and attack him if he gets careless with Lightning Rush.
[0] Always stay on hot foot and behind minions to avoid his basic attack and Thundering Shuriken.
[0] Do not push far to the enemy tower as Kennen can Lightning Rush through waves and towards you, therefore creating a trap.
[0] Always wait from safety if you are marked by Mark of the Storm.
[0] When in teamfights, remain swift and scattered to avoid his Slicing Maelstrom.
[1] Keep your distance from his (E). Keep in mind that he can close in using Ghost when (E) is on cooldown.
[2] Si Kenen fait une erreur spacing, je peux l'attaquer maintenant puis qu'il a pas de E.
[2] Je me mets bien derrière les CS pour pas prendre de
[2] Et il y a un monde où il envoie un E dans la wave et du coup je peux le choper en sortie de E.
[2] Tu donnes aucune opportunité de te mettre un Q ou quoi.
